color.note: One meaning per color, everywhere. Text stays in the ink tokens; a color marks which thing, and never appears without its label. Slide and figure colors (deck-) have one look and do not change with the theme.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind sections; also the ground of option buttons, readouts, the explanation box and the live panel's lead-in cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Boxes, tables, panels, charts, the glance and tooltips. Text on an accent fill uses surface as its color (white in light, near-black in dark), never literal white.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Table headers and group rows, inline code and pre blocks, the symbol legend's worked example, the step chip. The lowest-contrast ground: in dark three situation marks fall just under 3:1 here, so a mark on it always sits beside its label.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings, and also notes, captions, lead-ins and definitions, on every surface and tint (13.3:1 lowest in light, 9.8:1 in dark). Also the reference line in charts and in-chart direct labels.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: legend labels, table captions, axis titles, an option's description, the symbol legend's heading. At least 10.4:1 light and 8.4:1 dark on every surface and tint. Also the hatch lines and the pipeline arrows.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Very short labels only: axis ticks, readout names, chip text, a column name inside a phone card, the contents label. At least 5.9:1 light and 5.4:1 dark on every surface and tint; never a sentence.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table cell borders, box, panel and chart frames, the line under a section heading (h2), chart gridlines.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger edges: axis lines, grouped-header underlines, the left edge of a finding or a status line, the tooltip border, a hovered pipeline step, guide lines in Methods charts.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The interface color: primary button fill, focus outline (2px solid, 2px offset), option hover and selected border, range inputs, the numbered option dot. Not for running text: links use accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links, an option's "selected" label, chapter headings, the pipeline's "go to" link, the wide-table hint. 7.9:1 lowest on light surfaces; in dark it drops to 6.3:1 on tinted rows, so keep links off tints.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected option fill, the cell a tooltip is reading, the current value in a tooltip tuple, the lesson's chapter strip. accent-ink or ink text on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Text of the stall and of warnings: the callout's edge and bold lead, the warn tag, STALLED, a stalled value. 6.1:1 lowest in light, 4.8:1 in dark: short labels and terms only. Same red as k-stall; red means the stall and nothing else.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Callout fill and highlighted table rows (tr.hl). warn or ink text on it.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Pass and done: the ok tag, a passed check, the lesson's seen check mark. Text and marks.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a passed result. ink or ok text on it.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The channel's water in drawings: the tint behind the floats and thrusters.

tokens.name: water-ink
tokens.usage: Currents, waves and labels drawn in the water.

tokens.name: region
tokens.usage: Chart shading of the full-throttle region (svg .shade-region). An alias of k-region-soft.

tokens.name: sit-rec
tokens.usage: Recorded conditions (in distribution) and everything that is the recorded data: the recording controller, the weighting test's training data, pipeline step 1. Key shape: dot (situation), line (controller).

tokens.name: sit-strong
tokens.usage: Strong current (dynamics extrapolation); also the weighting test's lean toward strong currents. Key shape: dot. A mark, 3.0 to 3.5:1: always beside its label, never text.

tokens.name: sit-waves
tokens.usage: Big waves (disturbance shift). Key shape: dot. A mark, always beside its label, never text.

tokens.name: sit-kicks
tokens.usage: Big starting pushes (initial-state shift). Key shape: dot. A mark, always beside its label, never text.

tokens.name: sit-rec-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of recorded conditions: its table group row, its selected option, its key tile. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: sit-strong-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of strong current: its table group row and selected option. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: sit-waves-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of big waves: its table group row and selected option. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: sit-kicks-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of big starting pushes: its table group row and selected option. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: k-stall
tokens.usage: The stall: the stalling world, a throttle past 80% in it, the 80% line, stall shading. Key shape: line (world) or tile (stall area). Its text is warn.

tokens.name: k-stall-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of the stall: the stalling world's selected option and group rows.

tokens.name: k-rise
tokens.usage: Push keeps rising: the no-stall comparison world and the rising-thrust controller that assumes it. Key shape: line.

tokens.name: k-rise-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of the no-stall world: its selected option and group rows.

tokens.name: k-region
tokens.usage: Full throttle: the full-throttle region (water's push above 0.565) and the commands in it. An area color, 2.2:1 on white by design: drawn as a tint or tile, always outlined and labeled in k-region-ink, never a thin line. Key shape: tile; hatched tile when removed.

tokens.name: k-region-ink
tokens.usage: Outline, hatching, the dashed 0.565 threshold and the label text of the full-throttle region (5.1:1 lowest in light, 5.5:1 in dark).

tokens.name: k-region-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of the full-throttle region: area shading and its table rows.

tokens.name: k-learn
tokens.usage: The learned parts: the critic, the actor and BCA's band; pipeline steps 3 and 4; the dose line. Key shape: line; the band is two k-learn lines with k-learn-soft between.

tokens.name: k-learn-soft
tokens.usage: The inside of BCA's band, and the learned parts' tint.

tokens.name: k-ref
tokens.usage: The reference: the stall-aware controller, the 100 of the points scale. Drawn in ink.

tokens.name: k-none
tokens.usage: No throttle: the water acting alone. Always a dashed gray line.

tokens.name: step-collect
tokens.usage: Pipeline step 1, Collect the data: the recorded data's green.

tokens.name: step-remove
tokens.usage: Pipeline step 2, Remove commands: hatched, half full-throttle gold (main test) and half neutral (weighting test's 80% hold).

tokens.name: step-train
tokens.usage: Pipeline step 3, Train TD3+BC: the learned parts' blue.

tokens.name: step-band
tokens.usage: Pipeline step 4, Add BCA's band: drawn as a band, two lines with k-learn-soft between.

tokens.name: dr-hi
tokens.usage: Dot-and-range charts: the arms the chart is about (emphasis).

tokens.name: dr-lo
tokens.usage: Dot-and-range charts: every other arm, the de-emphasis gray. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: lq-1
tokens.usage: Data quality ramp, step 1 of 5 (faintest): random. One blue from worst data to best; each step at least 2.9:1 against the panel in both themes, always labeled.

tokens.name: lq-2
tokens.usage: Data quality ramp, step 2 of 5: medium-replay.

tokens.name: lq-3
tokens.usage: Data quality ramp, step 3 of 5: medium.

tokens.name: lq-4
tokens.usage: Data quality ramp, step 4 of 5: medium-expert.

tokens.name: lq-5
tokens.usage: Data quality ramp, step 5 of 5 (strongest): expert.

tokens.name: lc-none
tokens.usage: Learning curves: no extra caution. One hue family per kind of run; the six hues pass color-blind and normal-vision separation and 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: lc-none-2
tokens.usage: Learning curves: the untargeted controls (mauve, the second shade of the no-caution family).

tokens.name: lc-v5
tokens.usage: Learning curves: BCA's band as version 5 used it.

tokens.name: lc-v5-2
tokens.usage: Learning curves: second shade of the version 5 family.

tokens.name: lc-cmd
tokens.usage: Learning curves: the band weighted for the actor's commands.

tokens.name: lc-cmd-2
tokens.usage: Learning curves: second shade of the command-weighted family.

tokens.name: lc-ref
tokens.usage: Learning curves: the perfect lower edge and the full-data run, in reference ink.

tokens.name: toy-c1
tokens.usage: Toy charts: the BCA tail gate (blue circles). A chart uses at most three toy hues plus toy-ref; an entity keeps its hue and marker in every chart.

tokens.name: toy-c2
tokens.usage: Toy charts: the plain average (orange squares).

tokens.name: toy-c3
tokens.usage: Toy charts: split conformal (aqua diamonds). 2.8:1 on the light surface, under the 3:1 mark floor: kept as the source has it, carried by its diamond marker, its direct label and the chart's table.

tokens.name: toy-c4
tokens.usage: Toy charts: the BCA mean gate (violet triangles). An unweighted variant of a gate is dashed with hollow markers.

tokens.name: toy-ref
tokens.usage: Toy charts: the gray reference line.

tokens.name: m-ref
tokens.usage: Research interface charts: the reference values (site.css --ref).

tokens.name: m-rawq
tokens.usage: Research interface charts: the raw critic Q (site.css --rawq).

tokens.name: m-bca
tokens.usage: Research interface charts: BCA (site.css --bca). Its violet collides with k-rise: on a page that also draws the two worlds, draw BCA in k-learn instead.

tokens.name: m-dist
tokens.usage: Research interface charts: the distance-penalty method (site.css --dist). A mark, not text.

tokens.name: m-native
tokens.usage: Research interface charts: the native host algorithm, unchanged (site.css --native).

tokens.name: nv-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the contents drawer and the "In this section" sheet on narrow screens.

tokens.name: deck-ink
tokens.usage: Slides and figures: navy. Background of cover, part and question slides; headings, axes and the target line on paper.

tokens.name: deck-paper
tokens.usage: Background of content slides and of every figure.

tokens.name: deck-card
tokens.usage: Boxes and panels on paper.

tokens.name: deck-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and grid on paper.

tokens.name: deck-soft
tokens.usage: Body text and secondary labels on paper; axis edges and ticks in figures.

tokens.name: deck-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasized data in figures. A mark only, 2.95:1 on paper (just under 3:1, de-emphasis by design), never text.

tokens.name: deck-blue
tokens.usage: Accent 1: WBCP, Q1, the method working as intended. Lines and fills, and the kicker on paper slides (4.9:1 on paper).

tokens.name: deck-blue-light
tokens.usage: Light partner of deck-blue: bands and fills behind it.

tokens.name: deck-orange
tokens.usage: Accent 2: uniform BQ-CP, min(Q1, Q2), the failure being explained. Lines and fills only (2.7:1 on paper); orange text uses deck-caution. Also the rule under the cover title.

tokens.name: deck-orange-light
tokens.usage: Light partner of deck-orange: bands and fills behind it.

tokens.name: deck-on-ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on navy slides.

tokens.name: deck-on-ink-2
tokens.usage: Lead text and the byline on navy slides.

tokens.name: deck-kicker
tokens.usage: The uppercase kicker on navy slides ("Part 3 · Question 1 of 7").

tokens.name: deck-step
tokens.usage: The current question's dot in the progress row on navy; numbers in code on the code panel.

tokens.name: deck-step-off
tokens.usage: Numbers of the other questions on navy; the file-and-lines caption on the code panel.

tokens.name: deck-ring
tokens.usage: Outline of the other questions' dots on navy. 2.3:1: decorative, the number inside (deck-step-off) carries the state.

tokens.name: deck-code
tokens.usage: The code panel, on any slide (radius-deck corners).

tokens.name: deck-code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on deck-code.

tokens.name: deck-code-string
tokens.usage: String literals on deck-code.

tokens.name: deck-caution
tokens.usage: On paper: what is not yet shown, or only predicted, set as text.

tokens.name: deck-footnote
tokens.usage: Footnotes along the foot of a paper slide.

tokens.name: deck-row
tokens.usage: The highlighted row of a table on a paper slide.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, 600 and 700 only, tracked -0.01em. Headings, panel and card titles; never running text.

styles.name: ds-title
styles.usage: The page title (h1), once per page; fluid clamp(40px, 6vw, 58px).

styles.name: ds-section
styles.usage: Section headings (h2), with a rule hairline 8px below.

styles.name: ds-step
styles.sample: Why BCA's own band could not find the harm
styles.usage: A lesson step's heading.

styles.name: ds-subsection
styles.usage: Subsection headings (h3) and box titles.

styles.name: ds-card
styles.sample: Placement is almost the whole effect
styles.usage: Finding titles and lesson chapter headings (chapter headings in accent-ink).

styles.name: ds-strip
styles.usage: Pipeline step titles and the live panel's card titles.

styles.name: ds-legend
styles.usage: Group headings inside a symbol legend.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Source Sans 3. Running text is justified and hyphenated at desktop widths, left-aligned in boxes at phone width.

styles.name: tx-lead
styles.sample: BCA builds a band, a range around the critic's estimate.
styles.usage: The one-sentence summary at the top of a page or a lesson.

styles.name: tx-body
styles.sample: Past 80% throttle the propeller stalls: push 0.65 at 90%, 0.5 at full throttle.
styles.usage: All running text.

styles.name: tx-strong
styles.usage: Option group questions and other bold labels.

styles.name: tx-note
styles.sample: Every actor is scored on each situation's 1,000 fixed starts.
styles.usage: Notes, table cells, the explanation box.

styles.name: tx-caption
styles.sample: Dot: mean over five seeds. Line: lowest to highest seed.
styles.usage: Figure captions and pipeline step descriptions.

styles.name: tx-small
styles.usage: Tooltips, table captions, legends, the contents rail.

styles.name: tx-option
styles.sample: Made the data. Sometimes gives the full-throttle command.
styles.usage: The description line under an option button's name.

styles.name: tx-chip
styles.usage: Step chips and readout names.

styles.name: tx-tag
styles.usage: Tags (one or two lowercase words).

styles.name: tx-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above a list (the contents rail). Set in capitals with text-transform.

groups.name: Numbers and code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Every number that is compared sits in mono, right-aligned.

styles.name: mn-readout
styles.usage: Readout values in the live panel.

styles.name: mn-code
styles.usage: Code blocks (pre.code) and numeric table cells (td.n).

styles.name: mn-tick
styles.usage: Chart axis ticks, in muted.

groups.name: Slides
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for slide text, Source Serif 4 for slide titles, JetBrains Mono for code, on a 1920 by 1080 slide. Nothing below 24px.

styles.name: dk-cover
styles.usage: The cover title on navy.

styles.name: dk-title
styles.usage: A question or part slide's title.

styles.name: dk-heading
styles.sample: What the dots add up to
styles.usage: A paper (content) slide's title, in deck-ink.

styles.name: dk-lead
styles.sample: What it has shown so far, and what it has not.
styles.usage: The cover's one-sentence lead.

styles.name: dk-body
styles.sample: Check our implementation against the paper's own experiments.
styles.usage: Slide body text.

styles.name: dk-kicker
styles.usage: The uppercase kicker above a title, and the floor size for any slide text.

styles.name: dk-code
styles.usage: Code on the code panel.

spacing.note: The steps the reference page uses, named by their size in px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: a chart readout's gap, a tag's vertical nudge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; gap inside a readout.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inside chips and legend rows; between stacked lines of a finding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between buttons and option cards; a table cell's vertical padding; the gap under h2.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between items of a box; padding of readouts and the symbol legend.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between pipeline steps and option groups; side padding of chips and small boxes.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; side padding of boxes, callouts and details.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding; vertical padding of glance rows and boxes.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page side gutter; the symbol legend's column gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between the reading column and the contents on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between the reading column and the contents rail.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Between sections of the page.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest page: the reading column plus the contents rail.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the contents rail on the right, from 1000px up.

tokens.name: nv-w
tokens.usage: Width of the docked contents navigation.

tokens.name: nv-side-w
tokens.usage: Width of the docked "In this section" list.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Key tiles and the region mark.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the worked example, small menu items.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: The default: boxes, callouts, tables, option cards, buttons, tooltips, chart frames, pipeline steps.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Research interface section cards (site.css --radius).

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: The live panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, step chips, the compact pipeline strip, contents pills on narrow screens.

tokens.name: radius-deck
tokens.usage: Slides: the code panel and boxes.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: only things that float cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: The shared tooltip. The reference page is otherwise flat: borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-tip
tokens.usage: The dot-and-range chart's tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Research interface only: its section cards and sticky top bar.

stroke.note: Stroke widths in charts (SVG user units, px at 1:1).

tokens.name: stroke-data
tokens.usage: A data line: the stall and no-stall push curves, the dose line.

tokens.name: stroke-ref
tokens.usage: A controller's line (stall-aware, rising-thrust).

tokens.name: stroke-cost
tokens.usage: The throttle cost (dotted, dash-cost).

tokens.name: stroke-guide
tokens.usage: Knee and guide lines, an episode trace, a full-throttle point's outline.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: Axes and gridlines.

tokens.name: dash-guide
tokens.usage: Knee lines (the 80% stall line in k-stall; BCA's dose cap in muted).

tokens.name: dash-cap
tokens.usage: A cap or an assumed curve: the second cap, the rising-thrust controller's assumed push.

tokens.name: dash-cost
tokens.usage: The throttle cost line.

tokens.name: dash-threshold
tokens.usage: The 0.565 full-throttle threshold, in k-region-ink.

breakpoint.note: Layout widths the page responds to.

tokens.name: bp-readouts
tokens.usage: At or below: readouts two per row.

tokens.name: bp-rail

tokens.name: bp-dock
